name: GAN 356 i Carry 2
description: The GAN356 i Carry 2 UV 3x3 (10th Anniversary Edition) is a version of the puzzle that celebrates GAN's 10th anniversary. This puzzle comes with a special edition sticker set (one side) and cube bag. The GAN 356 i Carry 2 offers over 2x the battery life of the previous versions! And with the new GES Pro+ elasticity system, it is sure to be a top-performing smart cube.
